en.content: This page documents the shipped mask-image path only: webblocks-icons.css plus <i class="wb-icon wb-icon-...">. The grid below reflects the current shipped icon class surface.

en.subtitle: Valid icon classes
en.content: Current shipped class surface, including alias classes.

en.subtitle: Base glyphs plus aliases
en.content: Source page metadata is preserved as imported docs content.
This guide intentionally keeps the shipped <i class="wb-icon wb-icon-..."> usage that the package already supports. No older alternate icon docs are used here.

en.title: Aliases ship as real classes
en.content: wb-icon-refresh and wb-icon-refresh-cw map to the canonical wb-icon-rotate-cw glyph. wb-icon-sync maps to wb-icon-repeat.

en.title: Missing classes stay visible
en.content: Unknown wb-icon-* classes fall back to help-circle instead of rendering a blank square.

en.title: Use browser find for speed
en.content: Because this page is intentionally static and source-accurate, Cmd/Ctrl + F is the fastest way to jump to a name.
The list is alphabetized and shows every current shipped icon class, including semantic alias classes.
